name: Fake Linea token
rootCause: A fake Linea token is suspected of a rug pull for ~$1.3m. ~$743k has been deposited into Tornado Cash. Contract Address: 0x00000000fEB6A772307C6aA88AB9D57b209aCb18.

descriptions.text: A fake Linea token is suspected of a rug pull for ~$1.3m. ~$743k has been deposited into Tornado Cash. Contract Address: 0x00000000fEB6A772307C6aA88AB9D57b209aCb18.

Publicly available evidence for the reported October 2023 "LINEA" fake-token rug pull remains limited. Secondary reporting claims that a token deployed on the Linea network drained roughly 403.89 WETH from its liquidity pool before the operator moved funds toward Tornado Cash, but no independently verified transaction set or historical contract source could be confirmed from the available record. The available reporting describes an operator-controlled rug pull involving a fake token on the Linea network. Public evidence is insufficient to independently verify the claimed mechanism that the liquidity pool and token contract shared the same address or implementation.
